newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens lower after profit-taking hits Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens lower after profit-taking hits Dow.

text.p: UK shares started lower on Tuesday, reflecting a late sell-off in technology stocks in New York overnight.
The FTSE 100 index was 15.3 points weaker at 3,978.5 by 0835 GMT, with drug stocks leading the way after a fall in the ADRs.

"All this volatility is putting people off," said one trader. "Everybody is very aware that markets are higher than they have ever been before and they're worried about buying at the top, though there's still a lot of cash around."
Wall Street reversed early gains on Monday to end 36 points lower on the day. The Dow was up 31 points at the London close.
